name: iFixAi
tagline: Independent auditing of AI agents to uncover misalignment
description: iFixAi is an independent auditor helping companies assess whether they can trust their AI agents. Unlike relying solely on evals and observability tools, its multifaceted audit includes 250 inspections across 69 categories of AI misalignment, combining AI red teaming, operational assurance, and philosophical, ethical, and sociological perspectives. It identifies failures under testing, explains their business implications, and provides evidence engineers can use to investigate and fix them.

name: LUCI Desktop
tagline: Let your AI agents remember what you've seen
description: Luci saves your screen history and meeting transcripts locally, so agents like Claude Code, Cursor and Codex can help you find a page you forgot to bookmark or recall a decision from a call. Capture context across apps without setting up a connector for each one. Includes on-device transcription and daily summaries with Microsoft Foundry Local. Free for Mac and Windows.

name: ZenABM
tagline: Create, optimize & report on LinkedIn Ads from any AI tool
description: Ditch copy-pasting into Campaign Manager! Create, launch & optimize your LinkedIn Ad Campaigns from your favourite AI tool (Claude, ChatGPT, Perplexity etc.) with ZenABM’s MCP server or natively with our AI Agent Zena - both equipped with 20+ expert skills and 96 tools! +Automate your reporting (including company engagements & revenue attribution) with weekly & monthly reports produced by our AI Agents Zena.

name: Claude Sonnet 5.5
tagline: Anthropic's second model in the Claude 5.5 family
description: Claude Sonnet 5.5 is Anthropic’s fast, cost-efficient AI model for everyday work: coding, bug fixes, documents, slides, and design. It runs 30%+ faster than Sonnet 5, lowers task costs up to 30%, and delivers stronger coding and knowledge-work performance.

name: Semos.ai Manager Agents
tagline: AI agents purpose-built for managers
description: Manager Agents learn from your meetings, then point you to what needs your attention next: the feedback that is overdue, the recognition you missed, the conflict you are avoiding, the growth talk that keeps slipping. You learn what works, what doesn't, and why, so you become better at leading your people.

name: Paste 7
tagline: Intelligent clipboard that knows what you're about to paste
description: Intelligent Clipboard is new in Paste, the productivity app that remembers everything you copy. Paste now suggests which of your copied items you'll most likely paste next, based on what you're working on. Powered by Apple Intelligence, privately on your Mac.

name: Hopscotch AI
tagline: 500+ AI models available via a single API
description: 🎁 PRODUCT HUNT EXCLUSIVE: The first 250 PH users to sign up get $50 in free model credits. Create your free account and redeem code HOPSCOTCH50OFF in the Billing tab. | 🚀 Access 500+ AI models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and more through one API. Use multiple providers without managing separate integrations, accounts, or payments. Compare models on your prompts, configure fallbacks, and track usage and spend in one place. Pay provider rates with no platform fees or token markup.

name: Would you pay?
tagline: Find out who'd pay before you build more
description: Most side projects fail quietly: months of building, then nobody pays. Would you pay? shows your startup to real people who swipe right only if they'd pay for it. You see the % who'd pay, who they are, and who clicked through. Free.

name: Jotform Sign for ChatGPT and Claude
tagline: Create, send, and sign documents in ChatGPT and Claude
description: Jotform Sign for ChatGPT and Claude brings document creation and e-signatures directly into your AI workspace. Create signature-ready documents from a prompt or uploaded file, edit content and signing fields, manage recipients and signing order, send documents for signature, and track their progress without switching tools. Existing Jotform Sign users can also access and manage their workflows right from ChatGPT or Claude.

name: Timeless Code
tagline: Meeting notetaker that installs and runs inside Claude Code
description: An AI notetaker that lives inside Claude Code. Claude sets it up for you, and from then on you can record meetings and ask about anything that was said, right from your terminal.

name: Pokébinder
tagline: Plan your Pokémon binder, then print what's missing
description: A free binder planner for Pokémon TCG collectors. Search 40,000+ English and Japanese cards, arrange 3×3 pages, run your own art behind a whole page with cards on top, then print true-size placeholders for the cards you don't own yet. No account — your binder stays in your browser.

name: Engine Room Media
tagline: We Run The Numbers. You Run The Show.
description: Built for Creator growth, Engine Room brings all of your platform analytics, media kit, and rate cards together in one easy to use dashboard. Engine Room Media helps creators grow across all their favorite platforms (including YouTube, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, Patreon, Spotify, and Twitch) with data-driven insights, brand deals, and peer connections.

name: Curie
tagline: Assistant for scientific literature and document analysis.
description: Curie is an AI research assistant built for real scientific work, not a generalist chatbot. It searches PubMed, arXiv, Europe PMC, OpenAlex and Semantic Scholar in parallel, then verifies every claim against the source text, so you see what's backed and what isn't. Point it at a document to extract structured data with the quote behind each value, or run a full systematic review, protocol, screening, PRISMA diagram, with you approving every decision. Projects and a library keep it organized.

name: Arsaze
tagline: Let Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini edit your real timeline
description: Arsaze is the AI video editor for agents and humans — think Cursor for video editing. A real multi-track timeline that both you and an AI agent can drive over MCP or by talking to it, for AI video editing, AI video generation, and agent-driven video editing on one real timeline.

name: Imejis.io
tagline: Give your agent a design studio to automate your marketing
description: Your AI agent writes the copy. With Imejis, it ships the image too. Give Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, and other AI agents a design studio via MCP. Create, edit, preview, and render production-ready graphics. Build OG images, social cards, marketing graphics, charts, certificates, QR codes and more. Design once. Generate at scale. Unlike generative image models, Imejis is deterministic: the same input produces the same pixels, keeping your brand, layout, typography, and data consistent. Free to start

name: Gladys Assistant 5
tagline: Private, self-hosted smart home, no YAML required
description: Gladys Assistant is a free, open-source smart home platform that runs on your own mini-PC or Raspberry Pi. Zigbee, Z-Wave, Matter and 90+ community integrations, a phone-first dashboard, no YAML, and it keeps working when the internet goes down.

name: Declutr
tagline: Tidy your Mac's desktop and downloads in one click
description: Declutr sorts your Desktop, Downloads or any folder into folders by file type in one click: Images, Documents, Videos, Archives, Code, 3D Models and more. One Undo puts every file back. New since the first launch: it's on the Mac App Store, with Smart Rules (name, extension, age, size), watched folders that sort new files as they land, and a daily cleanup. Rules, not AI: it never reads what's inside your files. Free to sort, Pro is $8.99 once.

name: Supertake
tagline: AI that turn your ideas into real investments
description: Supertake transforms your unique takes on the world into real, shareable investment portfolios using frontier AI and trading agents. Until now, we’ve invested at the mercy of financial managers, ETFs, and single stocks promoted by grifters and algorithms. But with Supertake you simply tell the agent what you believe in natural language and it creates a magical portfolio of assets and places the trades on your behalf. Supertake works with existing brokerages like Robinhood and Coinbase.

name: Clink
tagline: The iOS keyboard you actually own
description: Clink is a custom iOS keyboard and a place for indie apps and brands to live on it. Themes, layouts and tools you control, plus partners who put their brand in the thing you type with all day. Privacy focused and headed to Android soon!

name: ShipHappens:
tagline: ASO, keywords & screenshots for the app store
description: App Store Connect is slow, clunky, and buries everything that actually gets you downloads. ShipHappens is the native Mac app I built to fix that. Pick keywords using Apple's own search popularity data, make screenshots with AI, translate your listing into 39 languages in one go, A/B test your product page, and reply to reviews in any language. A feed across all your apps tells you what to fix next. Your key stays in your Keychain, and you can bring any AI provider or run a local model.
